column1: # ZAP baseline rules for the release gate (spec §7.3). Every warning fails
# the scan unless it is listed here as IGNORE, with the reason.
# Format: rule id, action, reason (tab separated).

column3: (Storable and Cacheable Content: hashed bundles are cached forever and index.html is revalidated, on purpose; tested in internal/webclient)
(CSP: React Native Web injects style elements, so style-src needs 'unsafe-inline'; every other directive is pinned by TestThePolicyAllowsNothingFromElsewhere)
(Timestamp Disclosure: numbers inside the minified JavaScript bundle, not server timestamps)
(Modern Web Application: informational, the client is a single-page app)
(Dangerous JS Functions: eval appears in a bundled library; the CSP has no 'unsafe-eval', so the browser refuses to run it)
